name: Synchronoise
effect: Sound Based. If an affected target lacks a shared Type with the User, resolve damage as if this move were Ineffective against them (for determining base and minimum damage). If a target shares a Type with the User, add 2 Extra Dice to their Damage Pool.
description: The user vibrates with an odd energy matching its type(s). All nearby creatures and objects sharing at least one type with the user are hurt extra badly.
